mechanism_narrative: The level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is inversely related to S&P 500 forward returns: lower rates compress discount rates and increase equity valuation multiples, producing positive returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A unemployment rate above 5.0% signals a deteriorating labor market that increases equity risk aversion and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (<=0.5%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year) creates a 'stagflation' risk that increases equity volatility and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS <= 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate below 1.0% (annualized) indicates a late-cycle economic slowdown that increases equity risk and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth rate < 1.0% (annualized).

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPIAUCSL inflation rate above 3.0% signals persistent inflation that increases the risk of central bank interest rate hikes, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average indicates a weakening manufacturing sector that increases equity risk and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) level below 1600.0 (thousands) signals a weakening housing market that increases the probability of economic recession, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1600.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a labor market contraction that increases equity risk aversion and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS declines > 0.5% (mo) and UNRATE rises > 0.3pp (mo).
